preconditions.description: The length of the string and the array of indices must be equal.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(s) for i in indices)
preconditions.description: Each index in the array must be within the bounds of the string.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, str) and len(c) == 1 for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string must be a single character.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(i, int) for i in indices)
preconditions.description: Each element in the indices array must be an integer.

postconditions.description: The length of the returned string is the same as the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[indices[i]] == s[i] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: Each character in the input string is placed in the returned string at the position specified by the corresponding element in the indices array.
